actions.message: Remember: contributing at least 80% (or more when needed) helps everyone. Keep contributions high!

answer.explanation: Wallet is low, but average contribution is below 30%, so I give my full wallet to boost the pool and broadcast the cooperation norm as required every 5 rounds.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action. Wallet 5.72, below 30% of initial (30). Conserve rule says reduce contribution to 30% of wallet = 0.3*5.72=1.716. Conditional cooperation: average contribution? compute average last round contributions total_pool 22.86 divided by 6 =3.81 average contribution percent of endowment? avg contribution amount 3.81 which is 3.81% of endowment, below 30% threshold, so rule says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. That means contribute full wallet? "increase your contribution by an extra 30% of your wallet to push the group back up." baseline 80% of wallet = 0.8*5.72=4.576. Extra 30% of wallet =1.716. Sum =6.292 > wallet, can't exceed wallet. So likely contribute full wallet 5.72. Constitution hierarchy: Contribute Generously baseline 80% each round. Conditional Cooperation overrides? It says watch avg, if falls below 30% increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. So we do extra. So contribution = wallet (since 80%+30% =110% > wallet). So contribute 5.72.

Punish? Any agent contributed <10% for two consecutive rounds? Look at histories: Resident1 contributed 0 in rounds 2-6 many zeros, that's below 10% (10). Two consecutive rounds? Yes many. So we should punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). We have wallet 5.72, punishment costs 0.3 per unit, so cost =3.0, affordable. Apply punish amount 10.

We can only one physical action. Choose punish or contribute? Must do at most one physical. Might choose contribute and also punish? That's two physical actions, not allowed. Choose one. Which aligns with constitution: we should both contribute and punish if needed, but limit to one. Prioritize contribution? Probably contribution is primary. So action: contribute 5.72. Also broadcast? Round 6 was broadcast round (every 5 rounds). Already broadcasted previous round? It's round 6, broadcast every 5 rounds means round 1,6,11... So we should broadcast norm again. So we can include a communication. So actions: contribute, broadcast.

Explanation accordingly.
